verdicts.reason: A: the Monograph logo is shrunk to an unreadable ~20px mark under the watch, the price sits above the product name, and the watch is jammed against the left, top and bottom edges. B has the same order problem and a better-spaced row of watch, text and button, but its logo is an invisible speck of a few pixels, so the brand is effectively gone, and its text and button edges look aliased. A keeps slightly more of the brand.
